task_summary: Completely redesigned the Capstone Workflow Stepper from 5 cramped isolated mini-cards into a continuous horizontal milestone progression pipeline with gradient connecting track, active phase badge, completion percentage, and accessible keyboard/click tab navigation. Removed redundant double-card wrappers from MyProjectPage, ProjectDetailPage, and ProposalTab. Refactored FinalPaperUpload to standard Tailwind CSS tokens, eliminating dark mode color-mix regressions. Upgraded NextStepCard with proactive lifecycle CTAs across all phases. Enhanced ChapterProgressWithRounds with inline chapter upload buttons. Fixed mobile sidebar collapse in DashboardLayout and Sidebar to provide full viewport width on mobile devices. Full 6-stage Playwright lifecycle audit and all unit tests passed with 0 errors.
